purpose: Do not concatenate all five bands into one PCA. Model each frequency band separately (own Task-wise standardisation, own PCA, own prototypes), calibrate each band score with the Train OOF reference distribution, and fuse with Train-only weights. Test whether band-wise modelling raises the Test S1-vs-S2 diagnostic AUC above the E143 joint PCA-96 value of 0.7578.

features.band_order_source: research/E36_pure_eeg/config.json features.bands_hz (band-major concatenation, band b occupies columns [171*b, 171*(b+1)))

score.form: score = -d1, d1 = nearest same-task prototype distance (cosine-free Euclidean in PCA space, as in E143)
score.prototype_source: k-means (20 iterations, seed=17*subject) on standardised+projected features

methods.mean_z: equal-weight mean of per-band Train-OOF z scores
methods.rank_mean: per-band score -> percentile against that band's own Train OOF reference (ECDF), then equal-weight mean; monotone per band, no Test-batch statistic
methods.loso_weighted: weight simplex over the five bands (step 0.25) selected per acceptance rate by maximising mean Train LOSO rejection; Test is only scored
methods.greedy_forward: forward band selection with equal weights, criterion = mean Train LOSO rejection per acceptance rate, stop when no gain

fusion.selection_data: Train only (five-block Train OOF reference + LOSO folds); Test scores are never used to pick weights or bands

z_calibration: per-band mean/std of the Train OOF score distribution (five sequential blocks, prototypes from all other blocks); the same mu/sd is applied to LOSO and to Test
protocol: E143 clean protocol: Task-wise standardisation, PCA and prototypes fitted on Train fit_rows (frac<=0.6) only; LOSO removes the scored identity from the prototype set and uses fit_rows only; five sequential Train OOF blocks calibrate thresholds; Test is score-only; session labels are diagnostic only.
